about: The assets the client's town generator lays (town_rules zoning, the town_kits sets, the structure folders), one entry per kind. Each style's concept art draws every entry at its real footprint and storeys, so the art maps 1:1 to a build. `core` entries are what a town needs from hamlet to town tier.

assets.slot: home (hamlet, village): the plan's 7 x 7 body
assets.what: a small family cottage: one room with a hearth and two beds, a front door to the street, a small front garden
a two-storey family house: hall below with hearth and table, a chamber above with two beds, the stair inside, front door to the street

assets.slot: home (town, city): the 10 x 7 body at 3 storeys
assets.what: a tall narrow town house of three storeys in a street front, shop-like ground floor, chambers above

assets.slot: home (town): a terrace of three 7 x 7 houses
assets.what: a row of three joined small houses sharing walls, each with its own door and chimney, varied but clearly one row

assets.slot: home: the corner body (two street fronts)
assets.what: a corner house facing two streets, an entrance on the corner, windows on both fronts

assets.slot: home: courtyard house on a double plot
assets.what: a walled compound: a main hall across the back, two side wings, an open court with a tree and a pond, a gate on the street
a smith's house and workshop: an open forge front with anvil and quench trough on the street, the smith's chamber above, the trade's goods displayed
a farmer's house and barn-workshop: open front with hay, pumpkins and tools, a chamber above
a scholar's house: a reading room with shelves of books and maps behind a shop window, a chamber above
a small market stall: a counter showing the trade's goods, the trade's workstation behind it, posts and a roof or awning
the town square's centrepiece round the town bell: a monument, shrine or totem the town gathers at

assets.slot: forum front: the market hall (12 x 12)
assets.what: a market hall facing the square: an open arcade below for trading, a meeting room above
the town's tavern or mead hall: a taproom with a long bar, casks and a hearth, a hanging sign, rooms above
the town's temple or shrine: a sacred hall with an altar, the faith's symbols, candles or braziers
a granary or storehouse raised off the ground: sacks, barrels and grain bins, a hoist
a watchtower: tall and strong, a lookout platform with a brazier or bell at the top, a ladder or stair inside
a guildhall facing the square: an arcade on the square for the guild's market, a great hall above with a long table

assets.slot: wall: curtain 8 (tiled along the town's wall)
assets.what: a stretch of the town wall 8 blocks long: a walkway along the top with a parapet, buttresses, built to repeat
the town's gatehouse: a strong gate passage 3 wide through the wall, towers or posts either side, the town's banners over it
a wall tower at a corner of the town wall, taller than the wall, a lookout at the top
a stable for mounts: open stalls to the street with rails, hay and troughs
a farmstead on its lot: farmhouse, barn, a fenced yard with haystack and well, a kitchen garden
the harbour's customs house on the quay: an open arcade where cargo is weighed, the collector's office above, a flag
a warehouse on the quay: open loading bays, stacked goods, a hoist beam from the gable
the faction's trading ship moored at the quay: two masts, sails in the faction's colours, cargo on deck

assets.slot: harbour: mole head with lighthouse (9 x 9)
assets.what: a lighthouse at the end of a breakwater: a tall tower with a lit lantern room at the top
the founders' first camp: two tents, a covered cart with supplies, a cookfire, lamps
